verdicts.reason: A is a clean top-to-bottom reflow: the left-aligned text block, the product centred on the lilac circle and the CTA below it read in the right order. Its flaws are minor: the product is small inside a large circle, there are uneven gaps around the CTA, and the legal line is tiny. B makes "20% off" so large it nearly touches the right edge. It cuts the circle off at the top corner so it sits behind the headline instead of the product, and leaves the product floating alone at the bottom. The CTA is jammed against the subhead, and the fine print is about as large as the subhead, which weakens the hierarchy.
